finding: Within-cell bigram model D outperformed the three specified mathematics-inspired models in both C28 branches.
limitations: No decipherment or proof that mathematics is absent. Corpus already exposed; held-out scoring was not a genuinely prospective blind trial. Verification is not an independent audit.
